findings.claim: NeRD Physics is a functional simulated body/world mechanism, but mood/coherence are upstream parameters that directly alter gravity/damping/walk speed/joint noise and mood is reused when rendering body sensation text. Downstream mood/body/self-report correlation is therefore partly designed by construction.
findings.implication: Require mood/coherence shuffle/cut/lesion controls and separate raw simulated physical state, percept transformation and language interpretation.

findings.claim: NeRD room geometry/contact/transition rules provide deterministic world-model fixtures, while named rooms/AURA chamber are historical metaphors rather than current ontology.
findings.implication: Reuse typed geometry/contact/transition semantics, not literal stale room labels.

findings.claim: Sanctum RL explicitly rewards exploration, silence timing, diverse actions and 20-40min-style exit behavior while penalizing premature/late/repetitive behavior. Behavioral convergence is relative to this engineered reward function.
findings.implication: Do not interpret policy behavior as intrinsic goals/desires without reward ablations and reward-code/version ancestry.

findings.claim: Entity/AURA/world labels persist in historical simulations after corresponding systems were disabled or superseded; QUBOBuilder explicitly disables AURA reverse integration after Swarm replacement and old endpoint 404s.
findings.implication: Temporal provenance must prevent stale simulation labels from becoming current architecture truth.

findings.claim: Quantum Reflector is a classical 39-variable QUBO/annealing objective/readout over FRANK state; CoherenceMonitor compares current energy to annealed best state. The inspected code does not establish quantum computation or consciousness.
findings.implication: Reuse explicit objective/constraint/differential-state techniques only under mathematical semantics; 'quantum'/'coherence' labels carry no consciousness authority.

findings.claim: room_content and art contain procedural visuals, literature/philosophy/environment content and media assets. These are presentation/environment backing unless a separate causal path into cognition is demonstrated.
findings.implication: Media/content volume must not inflate mechanism coverage or earned-work credit.

branch_feedback.harness: Add mood/coherence body-loop interventions, reward-ablation policies, stale-label supersession tests and QUBO label/semantic guards.
branch_feedback.gwt: Simulated body feedback can enter workspace as a typed causal source, but must be distinguished from external sensor evidence and from language generated from the same mood variable.
branch_feedback.emergenz: Do not infer agency/desire from reward-shaped Sanctum behavior or consciousness from QUBO/coherence readouts.
branch_feedback.frank: Preserve current subsystem identities over stale room/AURA metaphors; treat NeRD physics as optional digital-body backing with explicit provenance.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Represent simulation/world/contact states and supersession edges separately from presentation labels; activation or naming does not grant current ontology authority.
